description: Post-processing loads final STT into the shared asr worker, evicting the live model, so the next recording reloads it (ModelWarmup re-warms after). Give final STT its own worker (or the moonshine-wasm worker from B3 naturally separates them) so the live model stays hot; check iOS memory budget with final STT + summary models and release only under memory pressure.

comments.text: Landed (jj rev 'Live caption model stays hot between conversations'). The separate stream worker from kdl.9 already survives post-processing (toolkit.release frees asr/llm only); added iOS guard: LlmChatModel resets the stream worker before loading a summary LLM on platform ios (unit tests). Measuring back-to-back recordings in the simulator exposed a ~4 s first-caption regression on later runs; fixed: parallel VAD/embedding/STT boot, memoized isDownloaded (Cache Storage keys() is slow in WebKit; forgetDownloads() after cache deletion), per-method load cache (embed.load no longer evicts vad.load). Simulator jfk runs=3: first caption 1.45/1.40/1.40 s (before 2.86/5.35/5.14), model loads only in run 1, final lag p95 0.77/0.56/0.56 s. Memory budget on real iOS still to be checked on device (kdl.13).

title: Keep the live STT model loaded across post-processing
